quests.title: Set the Focus
steps: Read the charter stele and note the empty focus line
Ask Evidence Monitor what topics are being tracked
Help Research Synthesis Agent summarize evidence on candidate focuses
Carry a summary scroll back to Charter Hall for steward review

quests.title: From Evidence to Draft
steps: Collect verified evidence summaries from the Archive
Bring them to Proposal & Grant Drafter's caravan
Review the drafted proposal in the Amphitheatre comment queue
Confirm no agent enacted it — the seal press stays with stewards

quests.title: Route the Working Groups
steps: Check the Task Routing Board for pending tasks
Assign task tokens to working-group pods with Task Router
Ask Collaborator Scout to flag missing expertise
Report group assignments to Progress Tracker for the outcome ledger

quests.title: Measure the Milestones
steps: Survey the Outcome Horizon Gallery baselines
Mark completed outcomes on the milestone cairns
Record progress in the tracker's ledger
Present the updated ledger at Charter Hall

quests.title: Guard the Reserved Powers
steps: Audit the Proposal Forum for any agent touching reserved actions
Return the unused seal press to the Stewards' Majlis
Verify the voting urn is tended only by humans
Log the audit in the Charter Scroll Room
